## Summary

Describe the MicroPython workflow and affected plugins.

## Validation

List each exact command and its result. State which clients and devices were

## Checklist

- [ ] Catalog aliases and plugin versions match.
- [ ] Shared skills remain portable; client-specific behavior is documented.
- [ ] No credentials, device backups, or personal device identifiers are included.
- [ ] Disruptive hardware and file operations remain explicitly scoped.
